# macOS UX surfaces

The seven kinds of Mac app surface across 14 UX dimensions, and each one checked against Apple's HIG and API docs (2026-10-25).

# Reference

* [macOS UX surface table](surface-table.md) - The seven kinds of macOS app surface (menu bar, desktop app, Settings, launcher, HUD, onboarding, system extensions) across 14 UX dimensions.

# Research

* [Surface table: findings and rules for every surface](00-findings.md) - What checking the surface table against Apple's docs found: the corrections, the rules every surface shares, and answers to open questions from the skills. (2026-10-25)
